description.value:
You learn to weave your technical skill fully into your use of the Force, gaining access to three effects — Disruption Pulse, Forced Override, and Techcasting Insight — choosing one to produce each time you use this feature.

You can use this feature three times, gaining one more use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level, and you regain all spent uses after a short or long rest.

Disruption Pulse. As an action, you release a 30-foot cone of electromagnetic energy that overloads enemy weapons. Any creature in the cone carrying or wearing a weapon with electrical components must attempt an Intelligence saving throw, made with disadvantage if the weapon is worn rather than carried; a creature with several such weapons saves separately for each. A weapon whose save fails imposes disadvantage on the first attack made with it.

Forced Override. When you cast a tech power that calls for a saving throw, you may impose disadvantage on that save at no action cost.

Techcasting Insight. As an action, you may attempt to read another creature's techcasting aptitude, making an Intelligence (Technology) check opposed by the target's own Intelligence (Technology) check. Success reveals the target's techcasting Max Power Level and any tech powers currently affecting it.
